Name: AutoFish
Author: WhiteMind
Description:
Auto play fish minigame and fishing rod auto hit.

[b]Version 1.6.5 is available for download. This release may have some issues as I couldn't do enough testing. Old configuration files may be invalid and need to be reconfigured. You can easily reset this using GMCM.
You can continue to use version 1.6.5[/b]

The basic function is auto fishing.

There are some options that can be set in version 1.6.5 (config.json):

MaxCastPower: Force the rod to cast with max power.
AutoHit: Auto hit when fish is bite.
FastBite: Fish will bite quickly when fishing.
CatchTreasure: Try to capture it when encountered treasure in the minigame.﻿Try to catch the treasure only when the progress greater than 75%.If this option is disabled or you encounter the legendary fish, treasures will be ignored.
fasterSpeed: bar move fast
triggerKeepAutoFish: enable auto fish function
keepAutoFishKey: which key to use to activate auto fish (default "Insert")
autoLootTreasure:Loot treasure automatically
autoLootFishAndTrash:Loot Fish and Trash automatically

If you are using GMCM, you can see them in Tooltip.
